name: Thomas Brophy
abstract_title: Revisiting Puthoff’s Unification of Physics and Metaphysics in the context of Generalized Orch OR Conscious Agency
abstract: Motivated by recent revelations about the potential existence of exotic technologies that interface consciousness with physical systems, we revisit Puthoff’s approach to the unification of metaphysics and physics in the context of a generalized orchestrated objective reduction approach to conscious agency. notable: PhD in Physics from University of Colorado Boulder. Worked on NASA Voyager II and Cassini spacecraft. Published in Science, Icarus, Nature, IEEE.
